name: openwiki-runtime-v1
used_as: the evaluator-owned .runtime of the OpenWiki agentloop tree: Node 22.12.0 for the lower agent, Candidate builds and the product start witness; pnpm 10.33.2 (and 11.15.1) for Candidate builds; candidate-smoke/repository/node_modules as the complete offline dependency tree mounted read-only for the Builder and materialized into every Candidate build

pins.pnpm-10.33.2: pnpm-10.33.2.tgz sha512 = a0 package.json packageManager pin
pins.node_modules: a0 pnpm-lock.yaml (sha256 6b0475e1...), pnpm 10.33.2 install --frozen-lockfile; better-sqlite3 compiled from source against Node 22.12.0

not_rebuilt: the paper-era .runtime also held pnpm-store-base (3.3 GB), openwiki-agentloop-probe-20260902 (500 MB) and a patched candidate-smoke checkout; nothing in the tree reads them (O2 §14)
notes: Built on the host (not in a container): the trees execute these paths directly and the agentloop sandbox binds them read-only. setup links <rendered tree>/.runtime to this directory; .runtime is excluded from every tree digest (audit_readiness, snapshot_trees, validate_formal_config).
